snippet.title: Atlas Fallen Reign of Sand - Major Update Announcement
snippet.description: Enter Reign of Sand, our next upcoming major update that will vastly improve your experience. We've worked hard to bring you new quests, new gameplay features, new enemies and an overhaul of your initial hours in our sun-drenched world. Most importantly, the Reign of Sand update will be completely free for everyone, whether you already own the game or not. Be ready for its release August 6, on PS5, Xbox Series X | S and PC!
